title: Mairie du 8e de Paris: 2026 marathon traffic and parking restrictions and ASO course map
publisher: Mairie du 8e arrondissement de Paris (city administration)
claims: The municipal page publishes the ASO 2026 official course map for the 12 April 2026 race, showing the start near the Arc de Triomphe/Champs-Élysées and the finish on the western Bois de Boulogne side near Porte Dauphine/Avenue Foch.
Traffic and parking restrictions were set by Préfecture de Police arrêté n°2026-00388 of 3 April 2026; the Champs-Élysées was fully closed from 7 a.m. to 3 p.m. on 12 April 2026.
Restrictions in the 8th arrondissement included Place de la Concorde and the George Pompidou underpasses (Concorde until 4 p.m., Alma until 6:30 p.m.), in force from 7 a.m. on 12 April.

Beyond the 8th arrondissement, Périphérique exits at Porte Dauphine, Porte d'Auteuil and Porte de Passy were closed from 7 a.m. to 6 p.m., and A13 exit 1 (Porte d'Auteuil, province→Paris direction) was closed 7 a.m.–6 p.m.
The page references about 60,000 runners expected under police measures for the event.
